title: 主语的确定
goal: 能根据谓语和语义角色确定英文主语。

points.label: 确定动作或状态对应的主体
选择与谓语语义相符的英文主语

sources.title: 大学英语六级考试大纲

body.p: 中文句子常先交代地点、时间或话题，再说动作。英文的主语要和谓语的意思对得上。翻译时先定谓语，再找出做这个动作的人，或者具有这种状态的事物。

body.box:
原文：在这座小镇上，居民保存着许多旧照片。
译文：Residents of this town preserve many old photographs.

cards.title: 人物施事
rows: 在集市上，农民出售当地种植的水果。
Farmers sell locally grown fruit at the market.
Farmers 是 sell 的施事。
每年春天，学生都会清理校园里的池塘。
Students clean the campus pond every spring.
Students 是 clean 的施事。
在旧剧院里，演员经常排练传统戏剧。
Actors often rehearse traditional plays in the old theater.
Actors 是 rehearse 的施事。
在旧剧院里，演员排练传统戏剧。
In the old theater, actors rehearse traditional plays.
地点放在句首作状语，主语仍是 actors。

cards.title: 事物特征
rows: 这座古桥的桥面十分狭窄，只容一辆车通行。
The old bridge has a very narrow deck that allows only one vehicle to pass.
The old bridge 是 has 的主体。
这种布料质地柔软，适合制作夏季衣服。
This fabric is soft and suitable for summer clothing.
This fabric 是 is 的主体。
这条河在冬季水位较低，河床露出水面。
The river has a low water level in winter, exposing its bed.
The river 是 has 的主体。
冬季，这条河水位较低。
In winter, the river has a low water level.
In winter 是状语，has 的主语是 the river。

cards.title: 动作名词化
rows: 保护湿地有助于维持当地的生态平衡。
Protecting wetlands helps maintain the local ecological balance.
Protecting wetlands 作主语。
定期检查设备可以减少工作中的安全隐患。
Regular inspection of equipment can reduce safety risks at work.
Regular inspection 作主语。
收集雨水能够降低花园的自来水用量。
Collecting rainwater can reduce the garden's use of tap water.
Collecting rainwater 作主语。
收集雨水减少自来水用量。
The collection of rainwater reduces tap water use.
名词 collection 作主语，of rainwater 是收集的对象。

items.stem: 原文：在画室里，画家每天修复古老的画像。选择译句。
options: In the studio, painters restore old portraits every day.
The studio restores old portraits every day.
In the studio, old portraits are restored every day.
Every day, the studio has painters restore old portraits.
items.why: 修复画像的是画家，painters 作 restore 的主语，in the studio 作地点状语。第二项把地点当成了主语，漏掉了画家。

items.stem: 原文：这种陶器表面光滑，适合盛放食物。选择译句。
options: There is a smooth surface suitable for holding food in this pottery.
This pottery has a smooth surface and is suitable for holding food.
This pottery is smooth surface and suitable for holding food.
Holding food makes the surface of this pottery smooth.
items.why: 表面光滑、适合盛放食物都是陶器的特征，this pottery 作主语，has 和 is suitable 是它的两个谓语。第三项把 smooth surface 直接接在 is 后面，不合语法。

items.stem: 原文：在秋季，工匠们使用当地的竹子编织篮子。排列译句。
items.why: artisans 是编织动作的施事，与复数谓语 weave 对应。

items.stem: 原文：保存旧信件有助于研究当地家庭的历史。排列译句。
items.why: Preserving old letters 是动作主语，与 helps 搭配。

items.stem: 原文：在夏季，这片湖水为附近农田提供水源。选择译句。
options: Summer supplies nearby farmland with water from the lake.
Nearby farmland supplies the lake with water in summer.
The lake supplies nearby farmland with water in summer.
In summer, the lake is supplied with water for nearby farmland.
items.why: 提供水源的是湖，the lake 作 supplies 的主语，in summer 作时间状语。第一项把时间当成了主语。

items.stem: 原文：定期阅读英文报刊可以扩大词汇量。排列译句。
items.why: Reading English newspapers regularly 是主语，can expand 是谓语。

items.stem: 原文：在车站里，志愿者为旅客提供路线信息。选择译句。
options: The station provides travelers with route information from volunteers.
Travelers provide volunteers with route information at the station.
At the station, there are volunteers and route information for travelers.
Volunteers provide travelers with route information at the station.
items.why: 为旅客提供路线信息的是志愿者，volunteers 作 provide 的主语，at the station 作地点状语。第一项把地点当成了主语。

items.stem: 原文：这种木材重量较轻，适合制作家具。选择译句。
options: This wood is light and suitable for making furniture.
The weight of this wood is light and suitable for making furniture.
Furniture made from this wood is light.
There is light weight in this wood for making furniture.
items.why: 重量轻、适合做家具都是木材的特征，this wood 作主语，is light 直接说明它轻。第二项用 weight 作主语，英文不说 weight is light。

items.stem: 原文：清洗过滤器能够改善设备的运行状态。选择译句。
options: The equipment cleans filters to improve its operation.
Cleaning the filter can improve the equipment's operation.
The filter can improve the equipment's operation by cleaning.
Cleaning the filter, the equipment's operation can improve.
items.why: 带来改善的是清洗过滤器这个动作，动名词短语 cleaning the filter 作主语。第三项让 the filter 作主语，动作的主体变了。

items.stem: 原文：在夜间，灯塔为经过的船只提供指引。选择译句。
options: The night guides ships past the lighthouse.
Passing ships are guided to the lighthouse at night.
At night, the lighthouse guides passing ships.
At night, the lighthouse is guided by ships.
items.why: 提供指引的是灯塔，the lighthouse 作 guides 的主语，at night 作时间状语。第一项把时间当成了主语。

items.stem: 原文：在这个村庄里，居民保留了许多传统习俗。排列译句。
items.why: residents 是保留习俗的主体，have preserved 与复数主语一致。

items.stem: 原文：这座图书馆收藏了许多珍贵的地方报纸。排列译句。
items.why: 图书馆是收藏的主体，单数主语 the library 与 holds 对应。

items.stem: 原文：保护河岸能够减少暴雨造成的土壤流失。排列译句。
items.why: Protecting riverbanks 是动作主语，can reduce 说明结果。

items.stem: 原文：定期维护机器有助于延长机器的使用寿命。排列译句。
items.why: Regular maintenance of machinery 是主语，helps extend 表示作用。
